intervention_description: Both randomised EIDP conditions merged into a single analysed sample. The 449 are the participants from six of the eight sites who joined the supplemental economic study, consented to SSA data matching, were verified, and had a Social Security Disability Analysis File record; 35 were dropped for having no SSI or SSDI record and 3 for dying before 2000.

Supported employment delivered by employment specialists on multidisciplinary teams meeting frequently to coordinate employment and clinical services, aiming at placement in competitive jobs meeting career preferences, with job search beginning soon after entry and supports throughout.

intervention_name: Usual services, alone or with unenhanced vocational rehabilitation
intervention_description: Coded control_active rather than control_tau because the control condition 'was defined as either usual services alone or usual services plus unenhanced vocational rehabilitation services', so part of the arm received a vocational service.

High-fidelity IPS supported employment from a three-person vocational team alongside usual mental health treatment, with annual fidelity assessment. The 51 of 68 result uses the whole allocated arm as its denominator; every other analysis in this report is restricted to the 51 who obtained competitive work, which is selection on the outcome and yields no employment proportion.
Whole recruited cohort of an observational early intervention service; no allocation. 232 screened, 174 met the enrolment criteria.

The 150 of the 198 enrolled who were diagnosed with schizophrenia or schizoaffective disorder; 'Participants with nonschizophrenia diagnoses were excluded for this report in order to employ the same eligibility criteria as the NH study.' A diagnostic subgroup of a randomised trial whose two case-management arms were merged, so it is not a whole recruited cohort and takes arm_type subgroup.

Men among the 756 cases. Results for men and women are a post-hoc split of one recruited register cohort, not two recruited samples, so they are subgroup arms rather than separate cohorts. No combined-sex employment rate is printed anywhere in the report, which is why there is no whole-cohort arm.
Women among the 756 cases; see the men arm.

Both allocation groups of the RAISE-ETP cluster-randomised trial (NAVIGATE coordinated specialty care and usual community care) analysed together, with treatment group entered as a moderator and clustering by site accounted for. employment_targeted_intervention is `unclear` because this report does not describe the intervention components at all, referring to the parent trial reports; the experimental programme is widely reported to include a supported employment and education component, which cannot be established from this source either way.
